sources.title: Air quality Environment Act target delivery plan
sources.role: Current national delivery plan for statutory air-quality targets.
sources.facts: Updated 16 July 2026 with revised measures, emissions data, trajectory methodology and modelling uncertainties.
sources.guard: National targets and trajectories do not establish measured or future air quality at a particular development site.

sources.title: England local air quality management policy guidance
sources.role: Statutory policy guidance for local air-quality management outside London.
sources.facts: The current guidance supports local-authority duties under the Environment Act framework.
sources.guard: LAQM duties and guidance do not prove a current exceedance, action-plan outcome or site-specific exposure.

sources.title: Air pollution and development: advice for local authorities
sources.role: Natural England standing advice on development emissions affecting protected sites.
sources.facts: Updated 19 December 2025 and sets assessment steps for emissions reaching protected sites.
sources.guard: Standing advice does not replace a proposal-specific assessment or prove acceptable emissions and mitigation.

sources.title: Local transport plans
sources.role: Current statutory guidance for local transport plans including clean-air delivery.
sources.facts: Published in 2026 and links transport planning with local air-quality duties.
sources.guard: A transport plan does not prove a specific scheme, air-quality improvement, funding or delivery date.

sources.title: Strategic noise mapping 2022
sources.role: Defra strategic noise-map publication for major road and rail sources.
sources.facts: The publication describes modelled noise data representing a snapshot of conditions in 2021.
sources.guard: Strategic modelled noise classes are not a site survey and do not prove current façade, indoor or future receptor levels.

sources.title: Noise Action Planning Important Areas Round 3 England
sources.role: National Data Library dataset for identified noise-action-planning areas.
sources.facts: The dataset record was published 1 July 2026.
sources.guard: An important-area polygon does not prove statutory nuisance, exact receptor impact or that mitigation is funded or delivered.

sources.title: Noise and vibration management: environmental permits
sources.role: Environment Agency permit guidance for noise and vibration management.
sources.facts: Updated 12 May 2026 and explains assessment and management expectations for regulated activities.
sources.guard: Permit guidance does not prove an operator has a permit, complies with conditions or causes no unacceptable noise.

sources.title: Noise and vibration risk assessment: using the noise advisory tool
sources.role: Current Environment Agency noise-risk assessment guidance and advisory tool.
sources.facts: The guidance explains that further information or impact assessment may still be required regardless of tool output.
sources.guard: An advisory-tool output is not a planning decision, permit decision or definitive measurement of future noise effects.
